podcast.title: Precursor to Paul Weller Movement
podcast.body: The Style Council was a band that originated from The Jam and subsequently evolved into The Paul Weller Movement, which preceded Paul Weller's solo career. "That evolved out of the style council, which all began with this band, The Jam."

xref.title: Father of Matt Weller
xref.body: Paul Weller, known as "the modfather" and formerly of The Jam and The Style Council, is the father of Matt Weller. "The modfather, Paul Weller, ex of the jam, and the style council has a son named Matt."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Noel Gallagher's Idol and Collaborator
xref.body: Noel Gallagher idolized Paul Weller's work in The Jam, The Style Council, and his solo career since childhood. They became friends, even living across from each other in London. Weller played lead guitar, whistled, and provided background vocals on Oasis' "Champagne Supernova" during the recording of the "Morning Glory" album. "Ever since he was a kid, no idolized Willers work in the jam, the style council, and his solo work."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Origin of The Style Council
xref.body: The Jam was the foundational band from which The Style Council evolved, subsequently leading to The Paul Weller Movement and Paul Weller's solo career. "which all began with this band, The Jam."

xref.title: Precursor to Solo Career
xref.body: This band existed as a project before Paul Weller's full-fledged solo career and was an evolution of The Style Council. "there was a band called the Paul Weller Movement."

xref.title: Solo Artist Evolution
xref.body: Before establishing himself as a solo artist, Paul Weller was associated with a band called The Paul Weller Movement. This group itself evolved from The Style Council, which had its origins in the band The Jam. "And before there was a Paul Weller, the solo artist, there was a band called the Paul Weller Movement."
